notes: Gemini API is metered and should not be used for routine coordination.
Codex and Claude are subscription resources and should handle suitable execution, verification, and review work.
Ollama/local models may handle low-risk triage and format checks only.
Groq and OpenRouter may be tested only through the free-model guard; no provider call should happen without an API key, daily cap, and explicit live invocation.
Kimi API and Cloudflare Workers AI are excluded from automation until their no-extra-cost status is verified.
